content-block-2:
Understanding Internal Medicine Consults

Internal medicine consults are specialized evaluations for pets facing complex or chronic health concerns. These conditions often require insight beyond general veterinary care, including cases involving the kidneys, liver, gastrointestinal tract, endocrine system, and immune disorders.

An internal medicine consultation provides a thorough health assessment and a customized diagnostic and treatment plan. Our team uses deep medical knowledge and state-of-the-art tools to uncover the root cause of your pet’s symptoms. Early and accurate diagnosis leads to more effective treatment and better outcomes for your pet.

At The Veterinary Internal Medicine Group, we bring specialty care to pet families in Miami-Dade and Monroe counties with unmatched compassion and expertise. Led by Dr. Armstrong, a board-certified internal medicine specialist, we put your pet’s wellbeing first and deliver answers when you need them most. Our mobile and pop-up options make specialty veterinary care accessible and convenient across Miami-Dade and Monroe counties and nearby areas.

What to Expect During an Internal Medicine Consult

When you bring your pet for an internal medicine consult in Miami-Dade and Monroe counties, you can expect a personalized, attentive experience from start to finish. Our veterinary team takes the time to understand your pet’s history, current concerns, and unique needs.

Comprehensive Health Review

Every consult begins with a detailed review of your pet’s medical records and current symptoms. Dr. Armstrong conducts a one-on-one conversation with you, ensuring valuable insights don’t get missed. Your involvement is encouraged at every step, reducing both pet and owner anxiety.

Advanced Diagnostic Evaluation

We utilize advanced tools and in-depth examinations to investigate your pet’s condition. This may include blood tests, urinalysis, ultrasound, and other specialized diagnostics. VIMG stands out by offering mobile ultrasound and same-day results, delivered by a board-certified internist. Real-time findings mean clearer recommendations without long waits.

Real-Time Results & Treatment Planning

Once diagnostic testing is complete, we discuss results with you in real-time. Treatment options are outlined clearly and addressed with compassion. We prioritize collaboration with you to create an individualized care plan for your pet. Follow-up questions are welcomed, and you leave the appointment with actionable next steps.

Ongoing Support and Communication

Our partnership doesn’t end with your pet’s visit. VIMG is dedicated to long-term care and continued communication. Dr. Armstrong is available for follow-up visits, telemedicine check-ins, and ongoing adjustments to your pet's care plan. This accessible, continuous support helps optimize your pet’s long-term health.
content-block-3:
Why Internal Medicine Consults are Important for Your Pet

An internal medicine consult provides targeted help for pets with complicated or unresolved health problems. Timely specialty care can mean earlier detection, more accurate diagnoses, and better-case outcomes, especially for chronic or life-threatening issues.

Consultations can help identify kidney disease, diabetes, liver disorders, gastrointestinal issues, immune-mediated disease, unexplained weight loss, and more. With a board-certified internist leading the process, you benefit from the highest standard of veterinary care, often without the stress of huge referral centers.

Early, Accurate Diagnosis

Internal medicine consults use advanced diagnostics to reach a faster and more accurate diagnosis. This helps guide better treatment choices and reduces unnecessary procedures or delays.

Individualized Treatment Solutions

Your pet receives a treatment plan tailored specifically for their condition, needs, and your family’s lifestyle. This approach maximizes results while minimizing stress on both you and your pet.

Long-Term Health Improvements

Prompt and effective specialty intervention can improve your pet’s quality of life and may extend their lifespan. Ongoing support from our veterinary team means your pet’s response is continually monitored and refined.

Signs Your Pet May Need an Internal Medicine Consult

Certain symptoms suggest your pet may benefit from a veterinary internal medicine consult in Miami-Dade and Monroe counties. If you notice these signs, timely attention is key:

  • Chronic vomiting or diarrhea
  • Sudden or ongoing weight loss
  • Persistent coughing or breathing issues
  • Increased drinking or urination
  • Unexplained lethargy, weakness, or changes in behavior

If your pet displays any of these symptoms, please contact The Veterinary Internal Medicine Group. Fast intervention can improve outcomes, especially for complex or severe conditions. Call our team today for guidance and to discuss your concerns.

How Often Should Your Pet Receive an Internal Medicine Consult?

The frequency of internal medicine consults depends on your pet’s individual health status. For pets with chronic diseases or ongoing issues, follow-up visits may happen every few weeks or months. Stable cases may only need periodic reassessment, while some consults are a one-time evaluation for an acute event.

Puppies, seniors, or breeds with known predispositions may benefit from more frequent monitoring. The Veterinary Internal Medicine Group customizes follow-up schedules to fit your pet’s condition and evolving needs. Our veterinary team will provide clear, personalized recommendations at every step.
